info.title: myecho Agent Content API
info.description: Machine-readable contract for content automation. Login tokens and scoped agent credentials are both accepted where listed; scopes do not bypass the user's role and ownership rules.

tags.name: articles
tags.description: Articles, editing versions, revisions, previews, and review submissions.

tags.name: agent credentials
tags.description: Scoped credentials managed with an ordinary login token.

tags.name: comments
tags.description: Moderation and replies; Editor/Admin role required.

tags.name: settings
tags.description: Public settings reads and administrator settings management.

get.summary: List the current user's agent credentials
get.description: Requires an ordinary login token. Agent credentials cannot list or create credentials.

200.description: Credential metadata; raw tokens are never returned

post.description: Requires an ordinary login token. The raw `mye_` token is returned once; store it as a secret. Omitted or zero `expires_in_days` uses 90 days; the maximum is 365 days.

201.description: Credential metadata and one-time raw token

delete.summary: Revoke one of the current user's agent credentials
delete.description: Requires an ordinary login token. Revocation is permanent.

get.description: Authors are restricted to their own articles. Results are paginated; `page_size` is capped at 100.

get.summary: Read an article and its editable version
get.description: Public articles can be read without credentials. For an authorized editor or the article's author, `detail.content` is the editable Markdown or HTML body. Agent access to editable content requires `articles:read`. Read `edit_version` before saving.

patch.description: Despite the PATCH method, send the full editable representation, including title and content; omitted properties can reset to defaults or clear values. Agent credentials must send `expected_edit_version` from the latest read. Status 1, 2, or 3 additionally requires `articles:publish`; status 6 additionally requires `articles:delete`. A stale version returns 409; fetch and reconcile before saving again.

delete.summary: Move an article to the recycle bin
delete.description: Preserves content and history. Use permanent delete only after confirming the article is in the recycle bin.

get.description: Public display feed. Authenticated article automation should use `/api/all_articles` to list manageable drafts and submissions.

post.description: Defaults to draft status 4. Agent requests require an `Idempotency-Key`; reusing a key with the identical request body replays the original 201 response, while a different body with that key returns 409. Keys are scoped to the current user. Status 1, 2, or 3 additionally requires `articles:publish`; status 6 additionally requires `articles:delete`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters, no whitespace. Required for agent credentials; optional for login-token clients.

post.summary: Duplicate an article as a new draft

post.description: Anyone with the returned link can view its immutable snapshot until it expires or is revoked. Treat the link as a secret.

delete.summary: Revoke the current user's article previews

get.summary: Read a revision body and metadata

post.summary: Restore a revision as an editable draft
post.description: Restoring a revision does not publish it. Include the current version in any later agent save.

get.summary: List review activity for an article

get.description: Editor/Admin role required. Defaults to pending status 2.
An author can read only their own submission; Editor/Admin can read all submissions.

post.description: Editor/Admin role and `articles:publish` scope required for agent credentials. A rejection requires a non-empty note (up to 500 characters).
The submitting author or an Editor/Admin may withdraw the pending submission.

post.summary: Restore a trashed article as a draft

delete.summary: Permanently delete an article in the recycle bin
delete.description: This cannot be undone. The article must already be in the recycle bin.

put.description: The `full_name` extension must match the original file extension.

delete.description: Deletion fails with 409 while the file is referenced by an article, submission, or setting.

get.summary: List content that references a file

get.description: Editor/Admin role and `comments:read` scope required for agent credentials.

patch.description: Editor/Admin role and `comments:write` scope required for agent credentials.

delete.description: Editor/Admin role and `comments:write` scope required for agent credentials.

post.description: Editor/Admin role and `comments:write` scope required for agent credentials.

post.summary: Moderate or delete comments in a batch
post.description: Editor/Admin role and `comments:write` scope required for agent credentials.

get.description: Unauthenticated reads include only public settings. Agent credentials must have `settings:read`.

post.description: Admin role and `settings:write` scope required for agent credentials.

get.description: Admin role and `settings:read` scope required for agent credentials.
Unauthenticated reads return public settings only. Agent credentials must have `settings:read`.

patch.description: Admin role and `settings:write` scope required for agent credentials.

delete.description: Admin role and `settings:write` scope required for agent credentials.

get.description: Admin role and `content:export` scope required for agent credentials. Includes Markdown/YAML front matter; local media is excluded unless requested.

post.description: Admin role plus `content:import` and `articles:publish` scopes are required for agent credentials. Preview first (`dry_run=true`, the default). Applying rechecks `edit_version` and reports conflicts instead of overwriting newer edits.

author_map.description: Optional JSON object mapping exported author names to user IDs; used on apply.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request (400; API error code 4001 or 4002)

Unauthorized.description: Missing, expired, or revoked credential (401; code 4011)

Forbidden.description: Role, ownership, or credential scope does not permit the action (403; code 4031 or 4033)

Conflict.description: Stale edit version, changed state, or idempotency conflict (409; usually code 4001)

ArticleStatus.description: 1=published, 2=pinned, 3=private, 4=draft, 5=pending review, 6=recycle bin. Unspecified article status defaults to 4.

expected_edit_version.description: Required on PATCH with an agent credential; use the latest `edit_version`.
